gaps.description: Foundational publisher full text or exact allele tables were not lawfully accessible; original R611Q spans remain unverified or cross-source only.
gaps.impact: These sources cannot ground stronger allele-specific statements in this bundle.
gaps.resolution: Obtain lawful full text/supplements and pin exact spans and licenses.

gaps.description: Full text is publicly readable or archived, but NCBI PMC OA API does not report an open-content license.
gaps.impact: Evidence may be summarized with short spans; redistribution of source content is not assumed.
gaps.resolution: Verify publisher-specific reuse terms before broader redistribution.

gaps.description: The IGVF file is public and controlled_access=false, but the file record exposes no explicit reuse license.
gaps.impact: The exact row can be cited; downstream redistribution terms remain unresolved.
gaps.resolution: Pin IGVF data-use/terms statement for this released file.

gaps.description: The contradiction report could not extract the compressed R611Q VAMP row.
gaps.impact: Resolved: row 8168, hashes, score, uncertainty and functional class are now pinned.
gaps.resolution: No further extraction required; preserve file/version hashes.

gaps.description: The same cliPE score is indeterminate under 2024 thresholds and abnormal under the 2026 cutoff.
gaps.resolution: Always report raw score plus named threshold version; never count as replication.

gaps.description: No R611Q-specific half-life or proteasome-dependence measurement exists.
gaps.impact: Ubiquitination and low abundance cannot be restated as demonstrated rapid degradation.
gaps.resolution: Measure controlled turnover, proteasome dependence and abundance rescue.

gaps.description: No direct R611Q folding, aggregation, thermal-stability, limited-proteolysis, hydrophobic-exposure, or degron-mapping assay was found.
gaps.impact: Misfolding and a defined degron remain unsupported.

gaps.description: No study restores R611Q abundance/complex formation and then measures intrinsic Rheb-GAP activity.
gaps.impact: Catalytic competence after stabilization cannot be assumed.
gaps.resolution: Use normalized/reconstituted rescue conditions with direct Rheb-GTP hydrolysis.

gaps.description: Wild-type residue 611 is modeled, but no R611Q mutant structure, defined Arg611-TSC1 contact, local ligandability analysis, fragment screen, or ligand-bound structure exists.
gaps.impact: No residue-local druggable pocket premise is supported.
gaps.resolution: Complete residue-level structure-quality review before any falsifiable pocket hypothesis.

gaps.description: Most low-throughput functional results are concentrated in one Nellist/Erasmus construct and assay lineage.
gaps.resolution: Report lineage-adjusted evidence and seek orthogonal independent-laboratory assays.

gaps.description: 621-101/621-327 carry R611Q plus loss of the wild-type allele and are tumor-derived/immortalized derivatives.
gaps.impact: They are not heterozygous patient-cell models and do not isolate R611Q stabilization.
gaps.resolution: Use genotype-defined orthogonal models and isogenic controls.

gaps.description: Literature alternates between NM_000548.3/.5 and exon 16/17 numbering.
gaps.impact: Alias mismatch can create false deduplication or structure-mapping errors.
gaps.resolution: Retain c.1832G>A/p.Arg611Gln and authoritative transcript/protein mappings with every record.

gaps.description: No compound has demonstrated direct binding, R611Q stabilization, complex rescue, or proximal functional rescue.
gaps.impact: No compound ranking or rescue claim is evidence-supported.
gaps.resolution: Entry gates and the ordered assay cascade must be satisfied before screening claims.

gaps.description: Atlas Gate 8 remains BLOCKED_HUMAN_REVIEW and accepted_claim_count remains 0.
gaps.impact: All mechanism statements remain source-reported exploratory evidence, not accepted Atlas claims.
gaps.resolution: Only the existing named-human Atlas review process can change claim status; this bundle does not.

gaps.description: The search is bounded to named/frozen sources, verified citation tracing and records available through 2026-08-17.
gaps.impact: Absence of a contradiction is not proof that none exists.
gaps.resolution: Repeat the documented protocol after the cutoff and on newly available lawful full text.

hard_boundaries: No Atlas claim acceptance or Gate 8 change.
No inference of misfolding, degron, intrinsic GAP rescue, druggable pocket, or compound rescue.
